Method of Attack: API with no authentication allowing anyone to access and view data
Hardcoded credentials and exposed API endpoints in app source code
Ability to block/unblock users, get user details, create new profiles
Attack Vector: Open API endpoints with no authentication

Exposed user data including profile id, creation date, username, email, ban status, hotscore, profile picture, followers count
Hardcoded credentials in app source code
